text: In modal HoTT (Shulman, Licata-Orton), modalities are endofunctors on types satisfying:
choices: They are monads (idempotent, unit η: A→◯A, and the map A→◯A is an equivalence on ◯-modal types)
They are functors to propositions only
explanation: A modality ◯ is a left-exact, idempotent monad: A→◯A is universal among maps into ◯-modal types.
